page.overview:
Who is Cecil Stedman?

Omni-Man Flaxans Damien Darkblood (banished) Machine Head Powerplex Force Fist † (victim) Knuckle Buster † (victim) Lizard League Komodo Dragon † Flaxancible † Omnivincible (indirectly) Hoodvincible † (indirectly)}}

Cecil Stedman is one of the three overarching protagonists (alongside Thaedus and The Immortal) of Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards.

For decades, he has served as the director of the Global Defense Agency, responsible for coordinating Earth's defense against superpowered threats and working alongside heroes such as the Guardians of the Globe and Omni-Man. Following the massacre of the Guardians, he led an investigation that determined Omni-Man was responsible. With the assistance of Invincible, Omni-Man was stopped before completing his objective of conquering Earth. After Omni-Man's departure following the destruction of Chicago, Cecil focused on strengthening Earth's defenses against future threats. His efforts included developing the ReAnimen and continuing Invincible's training to prepare for a potential Viltrumite invasion. Although his pragmatic methods caused great tension with Invincible, the two continued to cooperate during major crises, including the Invincible War.

Following the defeat of Conquest, Cecil secretly detained him in The Block for interrogation and experimentation in an effort to develop countermeasures against the Viltrum Empire. Two weeks later, a fully healed Conquest easily escaped, but Cecil kept his survival a secret from Invincible to avoid his wrath. Shortly after, the Flaxans returned to conquer Earth once more. This ended in failure but resulted in Robot and Monster Girl being trapped in the Flaxan Dimension. Cecil and the G.D.A. repeatedly attempted to rescue them but failed at every turn. Following the Viltrumite War, Nolan and Cecil tenuously reunited. Upon learning that the remaining Viltrumite still posed a danger to Earth, Cecil ordered Nolan to leave the planet, instructing him to return only if his people arrived. Additionally, Cecil began collaborating with Invincible on how to handle the looming threat of the Viltrum Empire.

Also known as: Cecil, Cecil Stedman GDA.
